          'carried=',[ (min(p[0] for p in w['boundary'])//4,min(p[1] for p in w['boundary'])//4) for w in Wb])

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seq=['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','LEFT','UP','SPACE']
for mv in seq:
    r=action([mv]); rr=last_action_result
    seg=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    N=[n for n in seg if n['color']=='N'][0]['boundary']
    Wb=[n for n in seg if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>=8]
    G=[n for n in seg if n['color']=='G']
    O=[n for n in seg if n['color']=='O']
    print(mv,'bc=',rr.get('board_changed'),'N=',[min(p[0] for p in N)//4,min(p[1] for p in N)//4],
          'G=',[ (min(p[0] for p in g['boundary'])//4,min(p[1] for p in g['boundary'])//4) for g in G],
          'O=',[ (min(p[0] for p in o['boundary'])//4,min(p[1] for p in o['boundary'])//4) for o in O],
          'carried=',[ (min(p[0] for p in w['boundary'])//4,min(p[1] for p in w['boundary'])//4) for w in Wb])
    if not rr.get('board_changed'): print('  BLOCKED'); 
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
